Title: Relic Revealer
Description:
Current version is v0.0.2
[h3]Now with 40% less Harmony![/h3]

Adds two popup UIs for tracking a world's relics and viewing its cherubim alongside the world's seed.

Includes options to have the UI popup displayed immediately after world-gen, immediately after loading a save, and by use of two activated abilities (one each for relics and cherubim).

Alternatively, wish for 'UD AskReveal' to display the base UI, or 'UD RevealRelics' or 'UD RevealCherubim' for the individual UIs.

[i][b]Note: the game's procedural generation is not perfectly deterministic. World seeds can't be used to reliably reproduce world generation.[/b][/i]

[h3]Existing Saves[/h3]
Relic tracking: limited.
[list]
  [*]Currently cached: full functionality.
  [*]Currently possessed: full functionality.
  [*]In reliquary: mixed, based on already looted or not.
  [*]Claimed but traded: if containing zone loaded.
  [*]Already Destroyed: none.
[/list]

Cherubim Viewing: full functionality.

[h3]Conflicts[/h3]
Minor use of Harmony to:
[list]
  [*]prefix RelicGenerator.GenerateRelic(HistoricEntitySnapshot, string, bool) - skips original if successful
  [*]postfix RelicGenerator.GenerateRelic(HistoricEntitySnapshot, int, string, bool).
  [*]postfix RelicGenerator.GenerateBaseRelic(string, int, bool)
[/list]

The prefix is to address [url=https://gitlab.com/freehold/cavesofqud-public-issue-tracker/-/work_items/100142]this[/url] issue tracker item, which the mod depends on for the reliquary relics.

The RelicGenerator postfixes are to store data on the relics for easier tracking.

None of these patches are [i]integral[/i] to the mod's operation, but any conflicts with them will degrade its quality.
